Under the fixed capital method, profit share and partner salary go to the Current Account; additional capital and capital withdrawn under the agreement go to the Capital Account. Thus the sequence is (I)–(B), (II)–(A), (III)–(B), (IV)–(A), option B.
A misplaces I and II; C misplaces III and IV; D misplaces I and IV. B is the only fully correct combination.

Under the fixed capital method, interest on capital and share of profit are credited to the current account; drawings are debited to it. Additional capital introduced is credited to the capital account, so option A is the sole correct match.
